Rework (AF-science-10): science/preregistration.md aligned with ethics/irb-packet.md section 9 'For Curie' items 1-8. (1) Stopping rule :98-109 adds withdrawals/AEs to the checkpoint review, T-arm pause triggers (advisor hold, one possibly related level-3 event, [N] level-2 events in first [M] T-arm sessions), both-arm pause, no new teams randomized in either arm during any pause, deferral and T0-repeat rule, resume rule, build-period sensitivity, individual distress rule (placeholder 7/10, unvalidated; 1 working day; level 3 response), site and whole-study stops. (2) Deletion vs ITT: Statistical models :144, Data exclusion :163 (data lock date, what is deleted incl. direct-report answers and log counts, minimal record team/arm/stratum/wave, AE records per ethics), Missing data :166 (deletion withdrawals imputed from arm/team/stratum; new sensitivity (d) excluding them and (e) deletion-only tipping point). (3) Difficulty item at close of T2 (repeat T3), :131 measured, :148 analysis, H2 :50. (4)+(8) Study design :64-68: same order both arms (content, closing with one-tap check-in, planning, T1); C-arm closing carries D3/D4/D6/D7; estimand stated as simulation over shared caveats; Manipulated variables :114 C-arm module frozen; rationale :42, H1-null :49, limitations :176. (5) Direct-report route (a) with count fixed before allocation, invitation condition [FILL], optional log counts :82, :117. (6) Ethics cover for advisor ratings/cognitive interviews :79. (7) All thresholds deferred to advisors, checklist :18. Checklist :13, :16, :21-23 and provenance :187 updated; summary :4 and power note :9 consistent; power numbers unchanged (rechecked 0.497/0.406/0.363). Ethics-owned consent/debrief text changes listed at :23, not edited.

Verifier R1 2026-10-15, independent re-check of science/preregistration.md (OSF draft). Criterion 1 hypotheses: met - H1 primary estimand with an explicit H1-null, H2 harm, H3 secondary, H4 intention-behaviour gap, H5 no stereotype taught. Criterion 2 power analysis: met - recomputed in python3: completers per arm 110/227/628, recruit 156/323/898, totals 312/646/1,796; rounding completers first gives 158/325/898 as stated; pilot 95% CI half-width 1.96 x sqrt(2/n x 0.75 x 1.2) with n = N x 0.35 gives 0.497/0.406/0.363 SD at N = 80/120/150, full width 0.99/0.81/0.73 (matches :9, :90, :160); completers 56/84/105 and 16-30 teams check. Criterion 3 analysis plan: met except one secondary outcome - ITT models, robustness, Holm family, harm monitoring, inference rules, exclusions and missing data with sensitivity (d) and (e) are complete. Open finding AF-science-10 (major): its content is resolved in this file - I checked all eight irb-packet.md section 9 items against :64-67, :79, :82, :101-109, :131, :144, :148, :163, :166 (distress rule, pause triggers, both-arm pause, deletion vs ITT, difficulty item, session order and check-in, direct-report route, ethics cover, C-arm closing D3/D4/D6/D7); the consent and 4.2 wording changes it needs are ethics-owned and listed at :23. Open finding AF-science-8 (minor) is NOT fixed: :124 (paste text) still calls 23 items the OMS-WA "full form" and :185 lists versions 23/11/9 without the 22-item version; my extended WebSearch today (summary level) relays the 2024 Lindsay et al. paper concluding the 22-item OMS-WA is reliable and valid and Szeto et al. 2019 using a 22-item five-subscale OMS-WA, so the measured-variable spec for the OMS-WA secondary analysis misstates the instrument. Gap (owner Curie, after V02 fixes AF-data-3): at :124 say five factors, 22 or 23 items unresolved until the full text is read, and add the 22-item version at :185. VERDICT: FAIL

Verifier R2 2026-10-15, science/preregistration.md (sha256 49da91aa). criterion 1 hypotheses: met - H1 primary estimand with H1-null, H2 harm, H3 secondary, H4 intention-behaviour gap, H5 no stereotype taught. criterion 2 power analysis: met - recomputed in python3: completers per arm 110/227/628, recruit 156/323/898, total 312/646/1,796, rounding completers first 158/325/898 as stated; pilot 95% CI half-width 1.96 x sqrt(2/n x 0.75 x 1.2) with n = N x 0.35 is 0.497/0.406/0.363 at N = 80/120/150, full width 0.994/0.812/0.726, completers 56/84/105, all as stated at :9, :85, :90, :160. criterion 3 analysis plan: met - ITT primary LMM with Kenward-Roger, robustness models, Holm secondary family, harm monitoring, SESOI/TOST inference, exclusions, MI with sensitivity analyses (a)-(e), exploratory list. Open findings: AF-science-8 content fixed - :124 now says five factors, 22 or 23 items, unresolved until the full text is read; 'full form: 23' is gone; :185 lists the 22-item five-subscale version; this matches data/instruments.md :41 and :64, and my extended WebSearch (summary level) supports 22 or 23 as unresolved. AF-science-10 content resolved - I checked all eight 'For Curie' items in ethics/irb-packet.md section 9 against :64-67, :79, :82, :101-107, :131, :144, :163, :166; the consent-form wording belongs to ethics and is listed at :23. Both findings still read 'open' in graph/audit/findings/science.json (auditor's record, not edited by me). No prohibited claim phrases (only the negation at :40). Gate stays: OSF posting needs the founder's OSF account. VERDICT: PASS
